title: One Last Harvest Together
source: 2026 big-game snack spot: an old farmer hands the family farm to his grown daughter
description: A quiet porch ask opens a song-led last season from planting to harvest, intercut with then/now memories of her childhood on the same land, and lands on a night-time handover of the farm keys, a hug, a generations super and an end card.
prompt30: Make a 30 s film for our new small-batch apple chips from this template: an old orchard keeper tells his grown daughter it may be time to retire, they work one last season together between then/now memories of her childhood in the orchard, and at night on the porch he hands her the orchard keys.
